nom: Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream

avis.texte: I used this lotion for the better part of a year with no side effects and good performance. I purchased this new bottle and it burned my under eye skin, resulting in irritated, flaking skin in a very sensitive area. Avoid, even if you have used this in the past!

avis.titre: Very disappointing and trashy product! Fake 5-star reviews!
avis.texte: All the 5 stars reviews are all fake or only paid for promotion! This product is nothing like the old version Eye Matrix Concentrate Serum which I used for 10years (one and only product I ever loved from Estée Lauder company). What is wrong with your company? Why discontinue a very good product and replaced it with trashy, watered down and ineffective one! Honestly, you'll lose your very loyal customers bec of your poor decision-making! Stop presenting fake 5-star reviews to lure your customers! Don't make us believe that this product is better than the old one because nothing is good at this product. It's skin-drying, eye-irritating, causes itchiness and it never performed the efficacy that was promised! It's a waste of money and time! My under eye skin gotten worse since I used this product. Bring the old formula if you want your customers to stay!

I've been using this product for the last 1.5 months and what a difference. After the first week I could see it was improving the sagging under-eye area. Now the improvement is dramatic.It glides on smoothly, no tugging and absorbs well. I will never go without this Eye lift & sculpt. Can't wait to see what my under-eye area looks like in another month.

I'm so disappointed that I paid full price for this. It gave me very large bags under my eyes and made my eyes very irritated. Please bring back the matrix with the cooling wand. That was the best. This version is greasy and awful.

I have used the old formula for years. This new formula burns the skin around my eyes and makes my skin beet red. I used it three times, thinking that maybe my skin needed to adjust to new ingredients. My skin reacted worse each time. I love the old formula, but I can't tolerate the new formula. I will have to shop for a different brand.

I have been using Advance Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt for about 4 weeks now, and this product is essential for days when my eyes appear tired and need to be perked up. I follow the application method of placing a dot of the product in four areas of each eyes, and my eye lis and upper eye areas look tighter and more awake by the time I am reading to dress for the day. This is my new favorite eye treatment and I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: Good product but NO security seal
avis.texte: Nice eye serum and absorbs quickly. I have sensitive skin (especially around the eyes area) and very happy that I did not experience any adverse reaction from this product. I deducted 2 stars because there is no security seal at all for the product - no clear wrapping for the exterior of the box nor any stickers to seal the top/bottom openings. Likewise, there is nothing to secure the interior bottle to ensure nothing has been tampered with. There are so many counterfeit products these days, Estee Lauder should take extra measures to ensure their products are tampered proof. I ordered couple of Aerin hand creams and similarly, they don't have any exterior or interior security seals. Drug store skincare products have better security protection than Estee Lauder...this is totally unacceptable!
This has gradually achieved its goal. Worth purchasing. It has tremendously corrected the sagging wrinkles around the eyes. Extremely satisfied w/ purchase. Bravo Estée Lauder.

Love the Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift +Sculpt! The dispenser is very stylish and ergonomically comfortable. It pumps consistently and smoothly. The repair cream is very creamy, moist and smooth. It goes on very easily and evenly. I've been using it for several months and find the little lines just above the cheek bone are no longer there and the crow's feet have lightened up as well. There's always a tad left on my; fingertips, which I use above and below my lips. I'm 83 and thanks to oily skin most of my life, I don't have many line on my face, but I'm now getting them below the eye alongside the nose, so I not only use the eye cream on my eyes, but I also press it in to the lines forming below the cheek bone and I find it has had a very positive effect, definitely preventing them from worsening. Thanks, Estee Lauder!
The cream didn't work for me ; my skin is more dry and I wake up with a little scratching, and the eye of the watery eye,

I tried this eye cream and really disliked. 1) It migrates into your eyes - so ONLY put it on right before you go to bed. Regular activities like blinking and sitting upright caused it to migrate into my eyes the first time I used it. 2) It gave me milia. Certain eye creams do this to me. I had been using ESTEE LAUDER Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix with great success - really loved the product, but they discontinued it. This was suggested as an alternative. It is NOTHING like the Matrix product in terms of consistency. And it does not have one of the things I loved about the Matrix product, the little application wand. The wand was great because you don't waste product and you don't have to wash your hands after application. I would literally apply it to my eyes while lying down - as final step of my beauty regime. Turn off lights and go to bed. I still use the original Advanced Night Repair serum (have been using it for over 15 years). And I love my Estee Lauder mascara - but I really wish they would stop making stuff then discontinuing it. (I'm still missing Fruition from back when I was still a teenager - lol)

Please bring the concentrate Matrix back. I use this product and I noticed dark ring around my eyes. I stopped using this product. I have always used the concentrate matrix which cleared up the dark ring, puffiness and wrinkles around my eyes

I love the product itself. My 77 year old eyes are firmer and smoother. Thank you for that. But the pump is terrible. Mine stopped delivering product weeks ago and I'm still scooping out the cream with a small spatula. Please redesign.
I have used this only a week twice a day along with the face serum. I can already tell a difference and my skin feels wonderful

avis.titre: Not as effective as I hoped, but good.
avis.texte: I am 67 and have very good skin to start with, but some crows feet and eye lid wrinkles like most. I am finishing my first full bottle. Goes on easily, a little goes a long way, I have used it faithfully AM and PM. Not greasy, absorbs nicely, no strong scent. works well under makeup. I would honestly say l don't see much change, maybe some slight improvements. I feel like the Youth Power Eye Balm worked better for me.

avis.titre: Bring back the previous version of this product!
avis.texte: This product caused severe redness, burning, and pain around my eyes so I discontinued using it. I am very disappointed as the previous version of this product with the metal applicator was amazing! It was thicker, did not irritate, and truly helped with fine lines. I had to return the new version of this product.

This is a new product. After trying the sample, I found it much more moisturizing and absorbed quickly compared to previous ones. It suits my skin type well, and I hope the full-size version will have discounts or promotional giveaways.
I love the cream however I took a star off as I don't like the applicator the metal stick is awkward to use

avis.titre: A great addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: absolutely love this eye cream! The texture feels luxurious and lightweight, yet it deeply hydrates and smooths the delicate eye area.
I was a little skeptical but ordered this product anyway. I was pleased to see that it improves the tone of my eyelids and undereye areas. I would recommend this.

avis.titre: Super expensive for a small product
avis.texte: I bought this thinking it was face cream. I didn't realize it was eye cream until I received it. It seems to work OK, don't notice any difference from other eye creams I've used.

Expected more. Been using this product daily for over a month and not seeing any particular results that would justify the price. Perhaps it works better on younger people. I am a fan of Estee Lauder and use several of their products but have to say this isn't one I would purchase again.

After receiving the amazing mega large holiday assortment of goodies,I decided to also splurge on myself with this eye treatment...Hands down the best product for eyes I have tried and I have tried many.The texture and feel is amazing.

I am pleased with the advanced night repair serum and its results. It is not only moisturizing but lifting and helps your eye areas to look both refreshed and more youthful in appearance. I will continue to faithfully use the product.
As a lifetime user of Estée Lauder this product is disappointing. It is like a watered-down version of the ANR Eye Matrix Concentrate that truly worked.

avis.titre: Need to give it more time
avis.texte: I've only been using it a little over a week, so I can't tell a difference yet. I do love the feel and how quickly it absorbs. I am using it with my Advance Night Repair. Hopefully I will see results soon and can return back here to give you further details.

I have been using the Advanced Night Repair Eye lift + Sculpt eye cream for two weeks and already noticed a big difference. The area around my eyes looks refreshed and well hydrated. It absorbs well and leaves my under eyes much softer. It seems to me that even the fine lines around my eyes have started to disappear. It is a great product and I will definitely continue using it.
Price is a bit high - but having used this now twice a day for two weeks, and just a tiny drop on each eye...a very noticeable difference in under eye wrinkles -- worth every penny
Like every thing else Estee Lauder, this serum is wonderful!!

I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes. I was kindly sent a 5 ml sample, and after using it each evening, I haven't noticed any significant improvements yet. I understand that skincare products often require consistent use over several weeks to show results, so this may take more time. The texture is smooth with a lightweight cream-gel formula. However, it does leave a greasy residue on my skin and takes longer to absorb compared to my usual eye cream, which is why I prefer using it only in the evenings. I also didn't find it to be as brightening as other eye products I've tried, so I unfortunately wouldn't purchase the full-size version.

I've been using the Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream for a bit, and it's actually pretty nice. It feels light and smooth, and it makes my eyes look a little more awake in the morning. It does keep the area soft and less puffy. I like that it doesn't sting or feel greasy, and a little really does go a long way.
This light and creamy formula soothes skin after cleansing. It absorbs quickly. Great moisturizing under the eye, reducing puffiness. Smoothes evenly over eyes adding moisture and smoothness.

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.i really enjoyed how silky and smooth this product was to apply to my eye area. It absorbed well and did not pill on my skin. No detectable fragrance to cause irritation.

This eye cream has a lightweight consistency, it glides nicely on the skin and it has a good and fast absorption. I like that it leaves no greasy or tacky feeling and it leaves my skin very soft and deeply hydrated. I only got to try a sample, so I cannot speak of long terms results, but so far I like it and I would like to add it to my rotation of skincare products. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I really enjoyed using this a part of my evening routine. It glides on smoothly and I could instantly feel that my eye area was more hydrated. I haven't used it long enough to see my wrinkles and fine lines fade much, but I'm hopeful with continued use, that will be the case. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I've experienced this product for years. I have to say that skincare is a long term procedure. I feel my under eye more mosturizer and brighter. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes
Handy and i love it i use everyday and i can see the effect on me so i highly recommend to my co worker amd i buy bigger size for my self thank you

"My eyes have been looking so much brighter lately, and I'm pretty sure it's because of this eye cream. The texture is light and absorbs quickly, making it easy to apply under makeup. I've noticed a visible reduction in the fine lines around my eyes after using this product consistently. It has been a great addition to my skincare routine and I recommend it 100% "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

This eye cream felt very nice around the eyes, I used it daily in the morning for about 3 weeks. The cream itself felt light weight and didn't leave an oily residue like some eye creams I've used in the past. I also liked the applicator and it doesn't have a scent so I appreciate that. I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I very much enjoyed this eye cream. After two weeks of daily use I have seen 'tighter' and more luminous skin in my eye area.I used this primarily at night after my typical skin routine, and occasionally in the morning on no makeup days. It is a rich and luxurious cream that is incredibly hydrating and absolutely silky. I do not yet have obvious wrinkles but I can attest to any fine lines being almost wiped out after continuous use. It has a slight, 'high end' skincare scent and has a beautiful and luxurious packaging. This is the Este Lauder I remember! While I was gifted this by Este Lauder and TopBox Circle, my review is 100% my true opinion. I absolutely would repurchase this on my own accord and plan to. I very much recommend this to anyone who is seeking not only results but a self care experience!

This serum is a dream! It hydrates, absorbs without greasiness, sits perfectly under makeup, and leaves my eyes looking youthful and refreshed while helping with fine line. "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

I really enjoyed this eye cream. I felt I absorbed really well on my skin and didn't feel sticky. It made my eyes look more bright and tighter underneath. I have tried other eyes creams before but this one was definitely a pleasant surprise and met my expectations. I will continue to use and definitely recommend.

This is a great night cream. It is easy to use and it feels great, not greasy on my skin. It is very moisturizing. It is a very high quality product and I would highly recommend this product to everyone. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. Opinions are entirely my own.

I've been using this eye cream for a couple of weeks. I can already see less crows feet, and plumping under my eyes, not to mention my undereye is so hydrated. I mostly use this at night as part of my nighttime skincare routine. However it works beautifully applied in the morning as well, I applied my normal daily makeup on top of this eye cream, and it wore perfectly. If you're on the fence about getting this eye cream, don't be, it'll be the best investment you can make. You won't want to be without the eye cream. I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This eye cream works great. It seems to help with my dark circles and puffiness. It has a soft, creamy texture. I like how it absorbs fast and doesn't irritate my eyes. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

received a sample-sized bottle of this product, and since I hadn't tried this Estée Lauder formula before, I wasn't sure what to expect. The applicator was a pleasant surprise, it makes application so insanely simple, quick and precise! The texture is silky and creamy, with a light, luxurious fragrance that feels like a real treat for the skin. It feels like it starts around 10 or so minutes to feel like it's absorbing for me, which I actually love because you can see and feel it working as it sinks in. My lower eyes are a major insecurity of mine as they're usually sunken so to see this actually plump my skin blows my mind, I'm sold! A little goes a long way, so even the sample size is lasting me quite a while. I've been using it nightly for about two weeks, and the difference in my skin is already noticeable. I can't wait to see the results with continued use! Overall, I highly recommend this, it feels indulgent, effective, and worth every drop!

This eye cream is light weight and is fast absorbing. I use it every night before bed. It is very smooth. It is easy to apply. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

Absolutely love this product. i've used many products that claim to do all these things, help with dark circles, help with wrinkles, lift the eyes, ect. estée lauder advanced night repair actually does what it claims to. i can see a real difference around my eyes.i can only imagine how they'll look after long use. so if you want a product that actually works, run, don't walk, to get this eye serum. i received this product for free from estee lauder for testing and review purposes.

I am very excited that I got to experience the amazing Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift Sculpt eye cream. I have been missing out and wish I had known about this product sooner. I like that this product targets all four eye diminsetions: lids, undereyes, my crow's feet, and inner corners of my eyes. I have noticed a difference already in just two and a half weeks, little changes around where my crow's feet would be. My skin feels hydrated, and the dryness around my eyes has improved significantly. I am happy with my new skincare routine and results. I recommend this product to those who want to experience change and get satisfying, real results. I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Perfect for Sensitive Skin and Daily Use
avis.texte: I've been using the Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt both morning and night as part of my skincare routine, and I've already noticed a positive difference! I really like the texture and light barely-there scent. The cream glides on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky residue, which makes it perfect under makeup during the day. I have sensitive skin, but I didn't experience any stinging or redness with this formula. Overall, it feels gentle yet effective. After a few weeks, the skin around my eyes looks a little smoother and my fine lines are slightly less noticeable. The results aren't dramatic yet, but my eye area feels more hydrated and refreshed, and I'm excited to see how it improves with continued use. I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cre
avis.texte: After using the Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream for a few weeks now, i must say i don't see a big different in the skin and fine lines around my eyes yet. Im hoping that continued use will make a difference in the next couple weeks.i do love the way the product feels on my skin and that it is not greasy but very moisturizing.its also absorbs into my skin well. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This product made my under eyes feel so soft and hydrated. Makes my makeup go on seamlessly without creasing or emphasizing my fine lines. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Great product wps my skin look hea
avis.texte: I received this product free to give my honest review. Definitely helped my dark circles and healthier

This product really works. I started seeing results within 4 weeks. It easy to use and you only need a small amount. It goes on smoothly. I would highly recommend this product to anyone. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.
It worked great for dark circles. As well as puffiness. I would recommend this product. I received this item free from Este lauder to review and test.

This eye cream is absolutely amazing! I love the bottle and the applicator, it makes for a nice and easy application. It is very easy to apply and absorbs fairly quickly. My under eyes instantly felt hydrated and brighter. After continued use my under eyes look more youthful and hydrated. I highly recommend!

I love how it made my under looked plump and bright! I definitely want to try it a little longer to see if my wrinkle and lines disappear. A little bit goes a along way. I used it morning and night, with my other Estée Lauder products, it definitely pair well with each other. I won't recommend to friends and families to try this product @ the counter for a sample first, before purchasing the big bottle. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: A staple for your nightly routine!!
avis.texte: I received this product for free from ESTEE LAUDER for testing and review purposes; & was extremely pleased with it. The application stick is perfect for applying the cream evenly under the eye area. The cream has a good consistency & dries quickly. It also didn't leave my eye area feeling sticky at all. I would definitely recommend this cream to my friends & family.

I was so impressed by how far this bottle went. A little dab is all you need for each eye. This was my first time using an eye product like this, so I wasn't sure what to expect. What a pleasant surprise when my fine lines actually disappeared! It did take a few weeks, but I am patient. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I had received estee lauder advanced night repair cream as a sample size and enjoyed every bit of it! The cream changed the texture of my skin. My skin felt softer after Applying. The cream is a velvety soft consistency. I highly recommend.

avis.titre: Skin Care That's Worth The Tag
avis.texte: I really wish I had a bigger bottle the cream was fantastic. It wasn't heavy or greasy. It was light and absorbed quickly. I'm am huge into skincare and absolutely loved this cream for so many reason my main would have to be how my eyes overtime seemed less puffy more hydrated which soften my crows feet. And a huge thing for me is the feel of a formula I can not deal with something on my face that is greasy or overly scented and this cream hit the mark on that too while delivering results. I will be getting myself a bigger bottle for Christmas.

I've really enjoyed the Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream. I received a sample size to try. It doesn't bother my eyes at all. There was no stinging or burning upon application.There is little to no scent, which I love. The product feels nice going on. My eyes feel well moisturized while wearing it. I feel that it can make some lines softer but they haven't disappeared yet. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I believe that there was a difference but I only had a sample size so maybe I'm just imagining it. It goes on so smooth and melts into the skin. It makes my under eye feel really nice and I plan on getting some more! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream and I'm really impressed. The texture is luxurious yet lightweight, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. Right after applying, I feel a surge of hydration and lasting softness around my eyes. As a 45-year-old woman with plenty of expression lines, I've noticed that this cream has helped smooth and refresh my eye area, making it look more awake and nourished. I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This is a great eye cream. My eyes look so much better since starting to use this cream daily. It's very lightweight and absorbs quickly. It is on the pricy side, but good quality products sometimes are, and the value is definitely there. It's effective and moisturizing. I look younger.

I love this eye cream from Estee Lauder. After using it for a week, now I noticed how my under-eye area look more hydrated and the fine lines start to disappear a little. Therefore, I highly recommended this product.

I love how lightweight and gentle this eye cream is. It does not irritate my eyes which can be quite sensitive. It hydrates the under eyes and also improves the darkness and puffiness of under eye circles. I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This eye cream exceeded my expectations. Not only was it smoothing and hydrating but I also felt like it was such a great base layer for my concealer and made it look airbrushed. It had my undereyes looking and feeling refreshed. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes
I live this eye lift cream. The texture and the results are what I expected to be. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

Estée Lauder's Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream has been a wonderful addition to my skincare routine. I have used it since its arrival. I have been accustomed to using instant-results-type products. When it comes to tightening, I can honestly say that I do notice a difference in the texture of my skin. I am going to give this product more time with its transforming results. I will continue to use it and keep you updated as well with my findings.
I have been using this product from 15ish days and I have noticed my eyes look sharp and better. I do not have any bulging under eyes anymore.i would recommend this product definitely

I have been using my Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair - Eye lift and sculpt and find the formula very soothing to use. I appreciate that there is no added fragrance to this Eye cream and how quickly it absorbs into my skin. My under eyes are left soft, without being greasy and the serum does not pill under my moisturizer which is HUGE! The biggest things I have noticed in my skin since using this serum were, that my dark circles have diminished, and my eyes don't look as puffy in the morning. I will say I do not feel like this serum is strong enough to eradicate or even decrease my fine lines and wrinkles. I have not noticed any changes at all in size or depth of my eye lines even with consistent use. In my opinion this is a very hydrating serum, that I will continue to use and purchase as it is super gentle and has helped the overall look of my under eye skin. I personally wouldn't rely on this serum for help with wrinkles or fine lines but, more of a hydrating serum in addition to something a bit stronger. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This product was very light weight but also felt hydrating. I have used this product for a few weeks and think it's perfect for my aging skin around my eyes. I would definitely recommend this product.

This is a lovely product that I would be thrilled to receive as a gift, but uncertain that I would purchase myself. I think there are other sculpting eye creams on the market that give similar results without the steep price tag. That being said, the formula absorbs easily and hydrates without any residual finish so you can layer your skincare or use it during the day. No fragrance, just the pleasant luxe skincare smell that you can expect from Estee Lauder. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Perfect to add to skincare routine
avis.texte: I recently had the chance to try Estée Lauder's Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream, and overall, it's been a pleasant experience. The texture is luxurious and smooth, absorbing quickly without feeling greasy, which is a huge plus for me. After using it for a couple of weeks, I've noticed a subtle improvement in the puffiness and dark circles under my eyes—though I wouldn't say the results are drastically transformative. The packaging is sleek and elegant, making it feel like a high-end product, and the gentle scent is pleasant without being overpowering. What stands out most is how hydrated my under-eye area feels, especially in the mornings when I tend to look a little tired. While it hasn't completely "lifted" my eye area as I hoped, there is a visible difference in firmness and smoothness. For those with sensitive skin, it's worth noting that I haven't experienced any irritation, which I appreciate. Though it's a bit on the pricier side, it does provide a noticeable boost to my skincare routine. I'd recommend it for those looking for a gentle yet effective eye cream, especially if hydration and reducing puffiness are your primary concerns. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.
This product was great. I felt a difference in my skin within a few days

avis.titre: Helps to firm under eye plus eyelid skin
avis.texte: I have dark under eyes and some fine line and very thin skin on eyelids which seems like wrinkles. After trying this cream for more than 3 weeks what I noticed its able to firms my under eye skin and eyelid skin to some extent. Its gives hydration plus gives smoother skin. Its really lightweight plus non greasy formula. It doesn't irritate my skin. Its becomes my everyday night routine essential eye cream.

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.I only had the chance to use for two weeks. It has a nice texture and feels good on skin, but results were minimal and I didn't see a sculpting effect.k

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. I am in love with this night repair eye cream. I have really dark circles and this has helped tremendously with softening the skin under my eyes. Even my makeup/concealer stays on longer and smoother! I highly recommend!
I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. This eye cream was great for my combo skin. No harsh scent. Wasn't sticky or greasy and didn't pill under makeup.

I've really been enjoying using this eye cream for the past few weeks. I like that the texture doesn't feel heavy or oily, but it's moisturizing and absorbs fast. I use it at night and in the morning under makeup and it doesn't mess with the texture of my makeup which is nice. The product and applicator feel nice and cooling when applied and I feel like it helps with my always tired looking eye appearance. Definitely helps with puffiness. Giving this one 4 stars because I haven't seen long term results yet as far as fine line improvement, but I'm liking the short term so far. I'm looking forward to continuing with this product. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

The Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift & Sculpt eye cream was extremely moisturizing. I'm 45 years old with fine lines and wrinkles and a bit of puffiness under my eyes. There is no fragrance with this product, which is a plus for me. I tested this product for about a month and would apply under my eyes every evening before bed. I would wake up with visably less puffiness under my eyes. If you haven't tried this product, you should! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes

avis.titre: My undereyes have never looked better
avis.texte: I've been using this product for about a month and I can already see a noticeable difference. My under-eye area looks smoother, less puffy, and my lids feel firmer without any greasy residue. It absorbs quickly, works well under makeup, and even the little lines I usually notice when I smile seem softer and less defined. The packaging is sleek and travel-friendly, and overall it feels like a product that truly delivers on its claims. I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Cream mostly in the evenings as part of my wind-down routine, and I really enjoy how lightweight it feels around the eye area. The texture is silky, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness. I noticed that my under-eyes felt more refreshed and hydrated in the morning, almost like I'd had a full night's rest. The subtle, almost non-existent scent makes it comfortable to use, especially since I'm sensitive to fragrances. Over time, I've seen a slight firming effect, particularly on the outer corners, which gives me confidence to keep it in my rotation. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

While I do not notice a very drastic difference in my under eyes in the 2 weeks I have been using this product, the formula is very hydrating and my under eyes do look more supple and less tired. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I have really been enjoying using this nightly. It feels very nice when applying under my eyes. I have noticed my under eyes are softer and look and feel more supple. I'm excited to continue using this. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I received the Estee Lauder night repair complimentary for Estee Lauder to give an honest review of the product.it works well I use it every night.ut get rid of puffiness under eyes but it's greasy and I didn't like the scent but it's effective

avis.titre: soothing and plumping, but results are gradual
avis.texte: I've been using this eye cream for a few weeks now, and it's definitely doing something. The texture is lightweight and silky, not greasy at all, and it sinks in fast without piling under makeup. I like that it doesn't irritate my eyes or leave a film—just feels nourishing and smooth. What I've noticed most is how much more hydrated the skin around my eyes looks. It feels firmer and more plumped, especially under the eyes and along the brow bone. Some of the finer lines look softer, and there's a subtle lifted look to the eyelids. Nothing dramatic, but enough to make me keep using it. I wouldn't say it erases deeper lines or completely transforms the eye area, but it does help with overall texture and puffiness. It's one of the few creams I've tried that actually feels like it's doing something beyond basic moisture. It also layers well with concealer, which is a big plus for me. One star off because the claims about lifting and sculpting are a bit overpromised—it helps, but don't expect miracles. Still, if you're looking for something gentle yet effective that hydrates, smooths, and supports firmness over time, this is a solid pick.
